prewrittenFacts.statement: The station visit was on 12 August 2004.
The train was cancelled, not delayed.
They did not board another train or visit Lahore.
Aunt Saira took them home in a green minibus.
Bilal kept the unused tickets in a school exercise book.

result.original: On 12 August 2004, my cousin Bilal and I waited on platform three at Mirpur station. Our train was cancelled, not merely delayed. We did not board another train. My aunt Saira collected us in a green minibus, and we went home without visiting Lahore. Bilal was eleven and I was nine. He kept the unused tickets in a school exercise book, between a drawing of a kite and a page of multiplication tables. That afternoon we ate lentils at home while the rain continued. I remember being disappointed, but Bilal said the station was the best part of the trip. The tickets were still there when he showed me the book the following winter. I do not know where the exercise book is now.
